name: CONSOLIDATA Marketing Checkup
audience: Owners and CEOs of already-selling consumer businesses in the United States

price.tax: Additional where applicable, shown at Stripe checkout

actionStatus: Purchase buttons open the hosted product-and-payment form directly, followed by shareable browser-local questionnaire

limitations: Self-reported selections, no independent account audit
No per-order access authentication or cloud storage
No guaranteed sales, profit or winning campaign
